passwordReset.subject: SparkyFitness Password Reset
passwordReset.bodyHtml:
You have requested a password reset for your SparkyFitness account.

Please click on the following link to reset your password:

{{resetUrl}}

This link will expire in 1 hour.

If you did not request a password reset, please ignore this email.

mfaCode.subject: Your SparkyFitness MFA Code
mfaCode.bodyHtml:
Your Multi-Factor Authentication code is:

{{code}}

This code is valid for 5 minutes.

If you did not request this code, please ignore this email.

magicLink.subject: Your SparkyFitness Login Link
magicLink.bodyHtml:
You have requested a passwordless login to your SparkyFitness account.

Please click on the following link to log in:

{{magicLinkUrl}}

This link will expire in 15 minutes and can only be used once.

If you did not request this, please ignore this email.
